findings.heading: Github issues / Đăng vấn đề lên Github
findings.proposition: When you write a Github issue, follow the instructions given below in this chapter to provide a minimal, reproducible example.
findings.reader_consequence: The Vietnamese reader is never told that the reprex instructions that follow apply to a Github issue, so they may post an issue with no minimal reproducible example and never connect the next section to the task they just started.

findings.heading: Github issues / Đăng vấn đề lên Github
findings.proposition: Be courteous when posting an issue, because most people who develop R packages and projects do so in their spare time.
findings.reader_consequence: The Vietnamese reader loses the etiquette warning and the reason for it at the exact point of writing an issue, so they may address unpaid volunteer maintainers as if entitled to support.

findings.heading: Posting to a forum / Đăng lên diễn đàn
findings.proposition: The English tells the reader to give a MINIMAL reproducible example together with their R session information; the Vietnamese moves the word minimal onto the session information and tells the reader to give a reproducible example with MINIMAL information about their R session.
findings.reader_consequence: The Vietnamese reader trims the R session information, which is exactly the part that should be complete (the chapter elsewhere recommends session_info = TRUE), and gets no instruction to minimise the example itself, so their forum post is both harder to reproduce and missing version details helpers need.

findings.heading: Github issues / Đăng vấn đề lên Github
findings.proposition: The green button on the right is labelled "New issue"; the English says only that it is a green button on the right and never names it.
findings.reader_consequence: Minor: if Github renames or relabels the button, the Vietnamese reader hunts for a literal "New issue" label that the English text never promised, and the two language versions of the handbook drift out of step on the same screenshot.
